column1: # Concept alignments: index of notes and pastoral themes <-> Dizionario di Teologia Biblica, index of
# notes <-> themes, and pairs of one index naming the same thing with no printed «v.». Seeded from the
# reviewed candidates of session R2 (revisione/R2/allineamenti-candidati.tsv: 393 accepted of 413) and
# reviewed again by F2 (7 «rivedere» -> 3 accepted; Magi/MAGIA rejected; directions of the head matches).
# da: index entry (note.<n>, temi.<n>); a: a Dufour entry (voce:<slug>) or an index entry;
# relazione: SKOS mapping property; metodo: label (same label), stem (singular/plural), altLabel
# (single-target redirect), rinvio (a multi-target redirect headword), head (head word, kept only
# with a shared verse or a reviewer's reason), mano (by hand), indici-* (notes <-> themes), doppione
# (same index); comuni: verses shared at the review (rdf.py recomputes them); chi: who reviewed.
